title: Pickle-based flavor loaders must check MLFLOW_ALLOW_PICKLE_DESERIALIZATION before unpickling
answers: SHAP explainer loads pickle even when pickle deserialization is disabled
how does MLflow block unsafe pickle loading for shap models
MLFLOW_ALLOW_PICKLE_DESERIALIZATION not respected by mlflow.shap load_explainer
why does pyfunc.load_model for a shap explainer need the pickle guard
body:
Symptom: Loading a SHAP explainer saved in pickle format succeeds with MLFLOW_ALLOW_PICKLE_DESERIALIZATION=false, while other flavors refuse (security advisory GHSA-hc9r-hv64-9g82).
Root cause: mlflow/shap/__init__.py:_load_explainer unpickled the explainer with no guard; the check existed only in other flavors' loaders.
Fix pattern: At the top of the pickle-reading loader, before any unpickle call, raise MlflowException with the workaround message when MLFLOW_ALLOW_PICKLE_DESERIALIZATION.get() is false and neither is_in_databricks_runtime() nor is_in_databricks_model_serving_environment() holds. The block was copied from the statsmodels flavor.
Constraints: Keep the guard in each flavor's loader; it is not centralized. Both mlflow.shap.load_explainer and pyfunc.load_model reach _load_explainer, so one guard there covers both paths. Any new flavor that unpickles must get the same guard.
applies: Any flavor loader or code path that calls pickle/cloudpickle/joblib-style deserialization in mlflow/ (sklearn, statsmodels, pytorch, tensorflow, pmdarima, langchain, dspy, pyfunc, model evaluation, shap).
says: Loading a model explanation still runs even when unsafe pickle loading is turned off.
Block model evaluation explainers from unpickling data when untrusted deserialization is disabled.
Security scans show explanation models bypass our environment setting against pickle deserialization.
Make explanation artifacts follow the same unsafe object loading restrictions as other models.
Prevent loading serialized explainers unless running inside approved managed runtime environments.
search: Flavor loaders performing pickle, cloudpickle, or joblib deserialization must raise MlflowException when MLFLOW_ALLOW_PICKLE_DESERIALIZATION.get() is false, unless is_in_databricks_runtime() or is_in_databricks_model_serving_environment() is true. In mlflow/shap/__init__.py:_load_explainer, this guard protects both mlflow.shap.load_explainer and pyfunc.load_model against unsafe unpickling per security advisory GHSA-hc9r-hv64-9g82. The guard is not centralized and must be placed individually at the top of each flavor loader, copied from statsmodels, across flavors like sklearn, pytorch, tensorflow, langchain, and dspy.
